facts.fact: TechnoMag reports POTRAZ handed over the country's first Data Controller Licences to 570 companies, valid 12 months across four tiers, with over 500 data protection officers trained, and no sanction reported.
TechnoMag reports the licences were issued under Section 4 of the Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024.
TechnoMag reports POTRAZ, with its Director General, issued the licences and runs the data protection training programme, acting as the regulator under the data protection regime.
